mapper.update: UPDATE analysis_job SET assistant_message_id=#{assistantMessageId}, available_at=#{availableAt}, updated_at=NOW() WHERE agent_id=#{agentId} AND session_id=#{sessionId} AND policy_version=#{policyVersion} AND status IN ('PENDING','RETRY')
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM analysis_job WHERE status IN ('PENDING','RETRY') AND attempts < max_attempts AND (lease_until IS NULL OR lease_until < NOW()) AND (available_at IS NULL OR available_at <= NOW()) ORDER BY created_at LIMIT 1
mapper.update: UPDATE analysis_job SET status='RUNNING', attempts=attempts+1, lease_until=#{leaseUntil}, updated_at=NOW() WHERE id=#{id} AND status IN ('PENDING','RETRY') AND (lease_until IS NULL OR lease_until < NOW())
UPDATE analysis_job SET status='COMPLETED', lease_until=NULL, error_message=NULL, updated_at=NOW() WHERE id=#{id}
UPDATE analysis_job SET status=#{status}, lease_until=NULL, error_message=#{errorMessage}, updated_at=NOW() WHERE id=#{id}
